get_default_batch_size: get the default batch size based on available GPU VRAM or fall back to CPU
move_model_to_device: move a PyTorch model to CUDA or MPS device with optional bfloat16 precision
check_gpu_availability: check if CUDA is available and compute batch size from GPU memory properties
convert_model_to_bf16: convert a PyTorch model to bfloat16 precision before moving it to the GPU
handle_mps_fallback: handle MPS device availability for Apple Silicon and fall back to CUDA or CPU
